hash_policy: sha256 is exact reviewed checkout bytes; sha256_lf_checkout permits Git LF/CRLF checkout conversion only. SMT queries have exact-byte hashes only. Prior 50 artifacts were verified byte-identical before/after this documentation change.
raw_artifact_rule: Preserve prior JSON/SMT/SVG bytes. SHA-256 is integrity, not a correctness or chain-finality claim.
